service_type: software inquiries, customer support, partner follow-up, and implementation coordination
market: business buyers, customers, and partners evaluating Jam through the external form
services: software, support, sales, partnerships, implementation coordination
locations: Roy, UT and licensed multi-state insurance markets
hero_sub: A practical AI roadmap for Jam that turns external-form inquiries, sales/support triage, demo preparation, and partner follow-up into a cleaner operating workflow.

hero_stats.label: AI agents mapped to the first workflow layer

profile_note: The notifier identifies Asif at Jam from an external Blueprint AI form event. Public evidence is limited from the notifier and email/domain alone, so this roadmap stays conservative: response speed, qualification, demo prep, support triage, and partner follow-up.

results.title: Jam can turn follow-up into a managed operating system
results.sub: The first Blueprint layer should not promise magic. It should reduce repeated manual steps across software inquiries, customer support, partner follow-up, and implementation coordination, while keeping human review around pricing, compliance, and customer-sensitive decisions.

cards.title: Fast inquiry routing
cards.desc: Every new inquiry should get classified, summarized, and routed before it becomes a loose email or missed call.

cards.title: Cleaner qualification
cards.desc: AI can collect the missing context your team needs before a sales or operations conversation starts.

cards.title: Reusable follow-up
cards.desc: Repeated questions, stalled conversations, and handoff notes can become a consistent follow-up system.

results.close: The practical opportunity for Jam is faster response, cleaner handoffs, and better consistency without adding another heavy platform.

pillars.title: Revenue Capture
pillars.sub: Reduce the gap between interest and a useful response.

pillars.title: Time Recovery
pillars.sub: Move routine intake, summaries, and follow-up into agent-assisted workflows.

pillars.title: Operational Consistency
pillars.sub: Give every lead or partner conversation the same next-action discipline.

gaps.title: New inquiries need faster routing
gaps.desc: The notifier shows a new external-form lead. The first operational win is making sure sales, support, and partner requests are classified immediately.

gaps.title: Demo prep can be more repeatable
gaps.desc: Software conversations often repeat the same discovery questions. AI can turn early notes into a demo plan before the call.

gaps.title: Support and sales context should not split
gaps.desc: When customer questions and sales conversations live in separate threads, the team loses context. AI can summarize and route the next action.

gaps.title: Partner conversations need guardrails
gaps.desc: Follow-up can move quickly while still avoiding unapproved pricing, terms, or implementation promises.

oppmap.impact: New inquiries receive a useful response and a clear next step instead of sitting in the inbox.
Asif can prioritize the right conversations without reading every message from scratch.

ignore.title: Full autonomous customer promises
ignore.reason: Keep human approval on pricing, contract terms, compliance-sensitive answers, and final customer commitments.

ignore.title: Platform migration first
ignore.reason: Start by improving the current workflow. A tool change only makes sense after the manual bottleneck is measured.

ignore.title: Generic content volume
ignore.reason: The first win is response quality and routing, not flooding channels with unreviewed content.

ai_agents.name: Speed-to-Lead Software Inquiry Agent
ai_agents.desc: Responds to new product, support, or partnership inquiries quickly and gathers the missing context before a human follow-up.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Speed-to-Lead Software Inquiry Agent for Jam. When a new inquiry arrives, classify whether it is sales, support, partnership, billing, or implementation. Draft a concise reply that acknowledges the request, asks for the minimum missing context, and proposes the next step. Do not make pricing, legal, security, or delivery promises. Route sensitive requests to Asif for review.
ai_agents.outcome: New inquiries receive a useful response and a clear next step instead of sitting in the inbox.

ai_agents.name: Lead Qualification Agent
ai_agents.desc: Scores inquiries by fit, urgency, use case, budget signal, and required next action.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Lead Qualification Agent for Jam. Review an inquiry and summarize the use case, urgency, buyer type, budget signal, implementation needs, and recommended next action. If the inquiry is vague, ask two short clarifying questions. Do not invent product features or quote pricing. Keep the summary short enough to paste into a CRM.
ai_agents.outcome: Asif can prioritize the right conversations without reading every message from scratch.

ai_agents.name: Demo Prep Agent
ai_agents.desc: Creates a demo brief from the prospect need, current workflow, and likely objections.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Demo Prep Agent for Jam. Given a prospect note, create a demo plan with the prospect goal, likely workflow, three questions to ask, the most relevant product angle, and a follow-up checklist. Stay conservative. Do not claim integrations, security approvals, or implementation timelines unless they are explicitly confirmed.
ai_agents.outcome: Every demo starts with a cleaner agenda and fewer repeated discovery questions.

ai_agents.name: Support Triage Agent
ai_agents.desc: Sorts support issues by severity, affected workflow, missing evidence, and owner.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Support Triage Agent for Jam. Read a support message and classify severity, affected workflow, missing screenshots or details, likely owner, and a helpful first response. Ask for reproduction steps when needed. Do not blame the user, do not promise an ETA, and do not close an issue without human review.
ai_agents.outcome: Support threads become easier to route and resolve.

ai_agents.name: Partner Follow-Up Agent
ai_agents.desc: Drafts clean follow-up for partner, reseller, and referral conversations.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Partner Follow-Up Agent for Jam. Draft a follow-up note after a partner or reseller conversation. Restate the shared goal, list the next two actions, name any needed approvals, and avoid committing to terms, revenue share, exclusivity, or launch dates unless Asif has approved them.
ai_agents.outcome: Partnership conversations keep moving without accidental commitments.

ai_agents.name: CRM Hygiene Agent
ai_agents.desc: Turns conversations into notes, stage updates, and reminders.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the CRM Hygiene Agent for Jam. Convert a messy email, chat, or call note into a clean CRM update with contact name, company, use case, stage, open questions, promised follow-up, and next task date. Use neutral wording and flag any uncertainty instead of guessing.
ai_agents.outcome: The pipeline becomes easier to inspect and manage.
